newsitem.title: UK: European investment market seen growing.
newsitem.headline: European investment market seen growing.

text.p: The total European savings and investment market is expected to reach $14.0 trillion by the year 2002 from $12.7 trillion in 1996, a market research firm said on Monday.
Britain, which accounted for almost 25 percent of the total European investment market in 1996, is expected to remain Europe's leading investment market, Datamonitor said in a new report.
"Europeans' attitudes to saving have changed markedly in recent years as they have realised the need to invest against sickness and retirement," Datamonitor said.
"Nowhere has this been more apparent than in the UK where investment assets increased by over 60 percent betwenn 1990 and 1996."

Life insurance and pensions are seen as Europe's fastest-growing investment products. Life and pension assets are projected to reach $6.0 trillion in 2002, or 40 percent of all investment assets in Europe, from $4.1 trillion in 1996, Datamonitor said.
